sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to New Mills on Saturday 14 November for an Edward Case Cup 2 South fixture at 15:00. The league leaders come into this cup tie in excellent form, having won their most recent league match and winning three of their last five league games overall. New Mills sit 10th in the league with 21 points and have shown inconsistent form recently.
divisionWide: Eccleshall (2nd, 31 points) and Wolverhampton Casuals (3rd, 31 points) both feature prominently this week, with Casuals hosting New Mills on Wednesday evening before Eccleshall's Saturday fixture against Bilston Town. Both sides are in strong form and remain close behind Sandbach in the title race. AFC Bridgnorth visit Widnes Town on Tuesday evening, with the visitors in excellent form while Widnes languish at the bottom with just seven points. Bilston Town, currently 6th, host Alsager Town (19th) on Wednesday before facing Eccleshall on Saturday—a crucial double-header. On Saturday, Allscott Heath (8th) host struggling Dawley Town, Brereton Social (13th) entertain Crewe (15th, winless in their recent form), Foley Meir (14th) visit Market Drayton Town (17th), and Wednesfield Community (16th) face Widnes Town. These lower-table fixtures offer opportunities for clubs to climb the standings.
